# Goal
Souji round 19 only, WAVE 1 — BUILD (+ first falsifiers). Lane root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin (absolute; jj-colocated; branch master; base 3ab2c81479f5004c8bc91946eea482caec45408f, short 3ab2c81). Round 18 was admitted by its non-author closure (corpus/lessons/round-18-verifier-spotcheck.md; routed D1–D5). Lane axes: calibration 7 (LOWEST non-retired), operability 8, coverage 8. Preregistration: .ufo/waves/round-19/preregistration.txt (read it).

Declared claims (causally separable, distinct axes):
C1 calibration (lowest) — the landing gate's carry check and the seat auditor's contract shapes tell the truth: a wrapped STATUS paragraph is matched as a paragraph, so an unmarked cut at a source physical-line end is LG-SEAT-UNCARRIED, a cut marked with … carries, and a complete paragraph carries; lesson bullets that themselves wrap are joined; the strict branch is gated at --round >= 18 so pinned replays do not move. Authorized patch delivery under .ufo/waves/round-<N>/w<k>/ and private /var/tmp/souji-r<N>-<Seat>/ workdirs are not false majors, while a tools/ write stays major and a signal call is a major.
C2 operability — revision stamps are durable and bind the measured bytes: census/round-13/run-verification.py, census/round-14/{run-verification.py,run-targeted.py,cache-demonstration.py} and both count-claims.py refuse a revision not reachable from refs/heads|refs/tags|refs/remotes (never refs/jj) or a tracked tree that differs from that revision: exit 2, write no record; historical 40-hex commands still run.
C3 coverage — F5 process residue gains its first admitted corpus/knowledge/ entry, sourced from man7 proc pages opened this round, plus its SKILL rule and README row; list-only, no reap authority.

# Contract (binding on every seat)
- You are ONE leaf seat. Never spawn subagents, never run its own swarm, never message agent://all. Do not call the `ask` tool.
- Write ONLY: (1) your report at the lane-relative path in your item, resolved under /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin — the rendered `Report:` trailer path is relative to the lane root, so write /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin/<trailer path>; (2) only if your item explicitly asks, ONE patch/artifact file beside that report with the exact name your item states. Never edit tools/, tests/, census/, corpus/, SCORECARD.md, LOG.md, PROVINCE.md, SKILL.md or corpus/README.md in the lane; L1 integrates. Never write to the fleet repo, a sibling lane, .ufo/state/, .ufo/watchdog.log, MANIFEST.json, scripts/, templates/, or census/operator-sweep-20261019/ (operator-owned: never open, never touch).
- No git or jj mutations anywhere: no add/commit/checkout/switch/reset/pull/push/stash, no jj command. Read-only git (log, show, diff, status, ls-tree, cat-file, rev-parse) is allowed in the lane. Do not run `jj-lane.sh`.
- Never signal a process; never read /proc/*/environ or any secret/credential content; no network except opening the exact public documentation URL your item names (curl/read only). No live census: do not run tools/souji-census.sh, tools/souji-proc-census.sh, tools/souji-verify.sh or any fleet-reading fixture. Executors may execute only a private /var/tmp copy of the exact file(s) their item names, against synthetic fixtures, never the lane tools in place.
- Scratch only under /var/tmp/souji-r19-<YourName>/ (no /tmp, no /dev/shm, no heavy HOME, never a global TMPDIR change). Clean up your own scratch at the end.
- Tool installs are authorized but PACMAN IS PAUSED host-wide: no pacman transaction of any kind. Use uv tool / npx / an official binary in ~/.local/bin only; read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first; record tool, version, channel and reason in your report. Prefer installing nothing.
- Evidence standard: never fabricate. An unrun check is unrun. Any quote is <=25 words with URL, access date 2026-10-21 and a located anchor. Cite lane-relative paths with line numbers. Your report's line 1 is `STATUS: DONE — …` or `STATUS: PARTIAL — …`, and it carries `# Findings`, `# Evidence`, `# Commands run`, `# Contract compliance`. If your item conflicts with this contract, report the conflict; never widen scope.
- The round-19 lesson and all round evidence are L1-owned. Work items are judged by L1; a wave is advisory, never a judge.
- Worktree state: the lane worktree may already contain L1's integrated r19 changes for C1/C2/C3 (gate wrap rule + selftest cases, tools/souji-rev-pin.py + r13/r14 wiring, auditor delivery shapes + V-SIGNAL, tests/fixtures/r19-{carry-wrap,rev-pin,seat-audit-shapes}.py, the F5 knowledge entry, SOURCES S079-S085, QUALITY Q36-Q38). When an item says "at the base", read those bytes with `git show 3ab2c81:<path>`. When it says review or verify, review the worktree bytes and name the bytes you read. Integrated state is never accepted as evidence; verify it.
